facts.business: Sindhu Trade Links Limited is engaged in the business of transportation of coal including allied services of coal mining, coal trading, and biomass businesses.
key_risks: Macroeconomic & Geopolitical Risks: Sensitivity to fuel prices, inflation, global economic conditions, geopolitical tensions disrupting supply chains and increasing crude oil prices.
Industry & Operational Risks: Dependence on coal value chain exposing to mining regulations, environmental policies, coal demand, competitive logistics sector, stringent regulatory approvals.

Execution & Financial Risks: Working capital efficiency, receivables management, proposed acquisition of Advent Coal Resources and Sainik Mining carrying execution, integration, equity dilution risks, interest rate and foreign exchange fluctuations, leadership transition after CEO resignation.
facts.related_party_note: The Audit Committee approved amendments in the Policy on Related Party Transactions and scrutinized inter corporate loans of the Company.
